features.text: Perfectly Flush for a Perfect Upgrade

Flush appliance installation is among the hottest kitchen trends, but rest assured the sleek, integrated design of this LG dishwasher will remain timeless. LG fits your space while fitting an impressive 16 place settings in a single load. It's an instant kitchen upgrade.
LG's Leading 1-Hour Wash and Dry

LG's exclusive QuadWash® Pro and Dynamic Heat Dry™ technologies combine to deliver our leading 1-hour wash and dry cycle for sparkling, table-ready dishes in less time. So you can spend more time on what matters.
Pro-Level Cleaning Performance

Tackle post-dinner cleanup like a pro with the enhanced cleaning power of QuadWash® Pro. High-pressure jets with 38% more cleaning power, spray dishes from multiple angles, while soaking them with over one million microbubbles to help break down stubborn food residue and provide exceptional cleaning performance.
Powerful Cleaning, Fewer Water Spots

LG TrueSteam® saves the time and headache of prewashing or rewashing dishes by hand. A blast of steam at the start of the cycle permeates and dissolves tough caked-on food but is gentle enough for your favorite wine glasses. A second blast during drying helps eliminate water spots by up to 60%—no more having to wipe spotty glasses before guests arrive.
Drier than Ever

LG's Dynamic Heat Dry™ technology circulates hot air throughout the dishwasher for faster, more complete drying. AutoVent™ Dry further adds to drying performance and energy efficiency by slightly opening the door at the end of the wash cycle to allow fresh air to circulate, delivering sparkling, table-ready dishes right off the rack.
Effortless Adjustment for Last Minute Items
The height adjustable 3rd rack gives you more space to fit everything from long flatware to small espresso cups.
Resists Smudges for and Effortless Shine

PrintProof® finish resists fingerprints and smudges to keep your kitchen looking its best. Available in black and classic stainless steel, now you can have all of the things you love about stainless steel appliances—the premium look, the professional-grade durability—without the need for special cleaners or constant attention. Plus, it easily wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth.
Cycle Completion Indicator
Now there's no more guessing when your dish cycle is complete. Floor status indicator projects a white light onto the floor just in front of the door to let you know when the cycle is finished.
A Smarter Home Starts with the LG ThinQ® App

The ThinQ app offers control and convenience to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home. Manage your smart LG dishwasher remotely, download additional cycles, activate voice control Google or Alexa voice assistants, and access smart diagnosis, customer support, and more.
Built In Leak Detection for Peace of Mind

ThinQ monitors water supply, drainage and leakage and will notify you if any issues arise after installation. Built right in for worry-free operation. Compatible models will alert you as soon as there is an issue.
So Quiet, You Can Use Your Indoor Voicea

Now you can run the dishwasher whenever you want—day or night. The 41 dB cleaning cycle is whisper-quiet, so you won’t have to worry about interrupting post-dinner-party conversations or naptime. Especially important for homes with open floor plans where sound readily travels from room to room.
Save Money. Save Energy.

Products that earn the ENERGY STAR label meet strict energy-efficiency specifications set by the U.S. EPA, helping you save energy and money while protecting our climate by making choices that count for a clean energy future.
